# Clauses of Binding
Every clause has a [bold]weight[/bold]. [bold]Prices[/bold] (positive weight) are taken from the mortal and make the deal worth more to you. [bold]Gifts[/bold] (zero or negative weight) are granted to the mortal and cost you. The weights on a contract must add up to 0 or more, or no mortal can sign it. [bold]Life Force[/bold], [bold]Swiftness[/bold] and [bold]Might[/bold] are tithes: what the mortal loses, the devil gains. Everything is returned when the devil is banished for good.
## Prices
### Time
[color=#999999][italic]150 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They die 10 minutes after signing, and nothing can bring them back.
### Humanity
[color=#999999][italic]80 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They are turned into a rat for 10 minutes. If the rat survives, they return to normal.
### Sight
[color=#999999][italic]60 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They are permanently blinded.
### Will to Fight
[color=#999999][italic]60 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They can never harm anyone again.
### Handshakes
[color=#999999][italic]50 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Both of their arms are torn off for good.
### Legs
[color=#999999][italic]40 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Their legs are permanently paralyzed.
### Awake
[color=#999999][italic]35 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They randomly fall asleep every 5 to 10 minutes.
### An Organ
[color=#999999][italic]30 Weight[/italic][/color]
- One of their organs is torn out and dropped on the floor. Usually the heart.
### Coherence
[color=#999999][italic]30 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They speak backwards and become clumsy.
### Strength
[color=#999999][italic]30 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They take double damage from everything.
### Soul Ownership
[color=#999999][italic]25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Their soul becomes yours. You gain a soul, and when they die they are dragged to hell. - Ticked by default on every new contract.
### A Hand
[color=#999999][italic]20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- One of their hands is torn off, and can never be reattached.
### A Leg
[color=#999999][italic]20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- One of their legs is torn off, and can never be reattached.
### Voice
[color=#999999][italic]20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They are permanently mute.
### Life Force
[color=#999999][italic]15 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They permanently lose 15 max health, left as devilish burns no medicine can heal. You gain 15 max health. They get it back if you are banished for good.
### Belittling
[color=#999999][italic]10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They grow to five times their size, and every step booms.
### Might
[color=#999999][italic]10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Their attacks deal 20% less damage, and yours deal 10% more (up to 50%). They get it back if you are banished for good.
### Swiftness
[color=#999999][italic]10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They move 10% slower, and you move 5% faster (up to 50%). They get it back if you are banished for good.
### Buckling
[color=#999999][italic]5 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They can never be buckled into a chair or bed again.
### Inner Peace
[color=#999999][italic]5 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They can only move one whole tile at a time.
### Intelligence
[color=#999999][italic]5 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Their speech turns to gibberish and they become clumsy.
### Weight
[color=#999999][italic]5 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They shrink to a tiny fraction of their size.
## Gifts
### Pain
[color=#999999][italic]-5 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They no longer feel pain, and wounds no longer slow them down.
### Fear of Crushing
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They become immune to high and low pressure.
### Fear of Drowning
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They no longer need to breathe.
### Fear of Freezing
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They can no longer be hurt by the cold.
### Foreigners
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They understand and speak every language.
### Gluttony
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They never need to eat or drink again.
### Greed
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- A fortune of 30,000 spesos appears in their hands.
### Mass
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They can't be dragged, and can't hide inside lockers or crates.
### Mimes
[color=#999999][italic]-10 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They learn to raise an invisible wall, like a mime.
### Diseases
[color=#999999][italic]-15 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Curses can't touch them, and they fight off diseases much faster.
### Fear of Clowns
[color=#999999][italic]-15 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They can no longer slip on anything.
### Fear of Electricity
[color=#999999][italic]-15 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Electric shocks can no longer hurt them.
### Fear of Light
[color=#999999][italic]-15 Weight[/italic][/color]
- Flashes can no longer blind them.
### Brokeness
[color=#999999][italic]-20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- A pair of autographed designer sneakers appears in their hands.
### Chance
[color=#999999][italic]-20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They receive one completely random clause, good or bad.
### Fear of Fire
[color=#999999][italic]-20 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They can no longer be burned by heat or fire.
### Death
[color=#999999][italic]-25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- The next time they die, they rise again once. - Ticked by default on every new contract.
### Fear of Death
[color=#999999][italic]-25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They never fall into critical condition. They keep standing until the moment they die.
### Shadows
[color=#999999][italic]-25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They fade from sight while standing still.
### Tardiness
[color=#999999][italic]-25 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They move noticeably faster.
### Weakness
[color=#999999][italic]-35 Weight[/italic][/color]
- They take half damage from everything, but holy power burns them more.
### Slaughter
[color=#999999][italic]-200 Weight[/italic][/color]
- A bottle of blood appears in their hands. Breaking it summons a slaughter demon.
